#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fill declared DOCX placeholders without editing inputs.

Rules enforced:
- Replace {{UPPERCASE_FIELD}} placeholders, even when split across runs in a
  single paragraph (no cross-paragraph tokens).
- Process body, nested tables, and all active headers/footers.
- Conditional {{IF_RELOCATION}}...{{END_IF_RELOCATION}} is governed ONLY by
  RELOCATION_PACKAGE. Keep inner content iff value == "Yes" (exact). Any other
  value removes it. RELOCATION_PACKAGE is required whenever conditional appears.
- 'RELOCATION' and other extra keys are never used as aliases/fallbacks.
- Missing required value -> exit nonzero with report.
"""
import sys
import json
import re
import zipfile
import shutil
import os

TEMPLATE = "inputs/offer_letter_template.docx"
DATA = "inputs/employee_data.json"
OUTPUT = "output/offer_letter_filled.docx"

W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

# Placeholder + conditional token patterns
TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}")
IF_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*IF_RELOCATION\s*\}\}(.*?)\{\{\s*END_IF_RELOCATION\s*\}\}", re.DOTALL)
GOVERNING = "RELOCATION_PACKAGE"
# Field names that are substitution placeholders (not control tokens)
CONTROL_TOKENS = {"IF_RELOCATION", "END_IF_RELOCATION"}


def fail(msg):
    sys.stderr.write("ERROR: " + msg + "\n")
    sys.exit(1)


def load_data():
    with open(DATA, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


# -------- XML paragraph-run manipulation --------
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ET.register_namespace("", W_NS)
# register all namespaces present so serialization keeps prefixes
NSMAP = {
    "wpc": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordprocessingCanvas",
    "mo": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/mac/office/2008/main",
    "mc": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006",
    "mv": "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:mac:vml",
    "o": "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/math",
    "v": "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml",
    "wp14": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordprocessingDrawing",
    "wp": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing",
    "w10": "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word",
    "w": W_NS,
    "w14": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml",
    "wpg": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordprocessingGroup",
    "wpi": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordprocessingInk",
    "wne": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2006/wordml",
    "wps": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordprocessingShape",
}
for p, u in NSMAP.items():
    ET.register_namespace(p, u)


def qn(tag):
    return "{%s}%s" % (W_NS, tag)


def get_run_text_elems(p):
    """Return list of (run_elem, t_elem) for w:t directly inside w:r within paragraph p.
    Only direct children runs of the paragraph are treated as the token scope."""
    results = []
    for r in p.findall(qn("r")):
        t = r.find(qn("t"))
        if t is not None:
            results.append((r, t))
    return results


class Missing(Exception):
    pass


def resolve_token(name, data):
    if name not in data:
        raise Missing(name)
    return str(data[name])


def transform_text(text, data, missing_set):
    """Apply conditional then placeholder substitution to a paragraph's combined text.
    Scope is a single paragraph (no cross-paragraph tokens)."""
    # 1) conditional blocks
    def cond_repl(m):
        if GOVERNING not in data:
            missing_set.add(GOVERNING)
            return m.group(0)  # leave; will be reported as error
        keep = (str(data[GOVERNING]) == "Yes")
        inner = m.group(1)
        if not keep:
            return ""
        return inner
    text = IF_RE.sub(cond_repl, text)

    # 2) placeholder substitution
    def tok_repl(m):
        name = m.group(1)
        if name in CONTROL_TOKENS:
            # stray control token (unbalanced) - leave for visibility/error
            return m.group(0)
        if name not in data:
            missing_set.add(name)
            return m.group(0)
        return str(data[name])
    text = TOKEN_RE.sub(tok_repl, text)
    return text


def process_paragraph(p, data, missing_set):
    runs = get_run_text_elems(p)
    if not runs:
        return
    combined = "".join(t.text or "" for (_, t) in runs)
    if "{{" not in combined:
        return
    new = transform_text(combined, data, missing_set)
    if new == combined:
        return
    # Write entire new text into first run's t; clear the rest.
    first_r, first_t = runs[0]
    first_t.text = new
    # preserve space semantics
    first_t.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space", "preserve")
    for (_, t) in runs[1:]:
        t.text = ""


def iter_paragraphs(elem):
    for p in elem.iter(qn("p")):
        yield p


def process_xml(xml_bytes, data, missing_set):
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_bytes)
    for p in iter_paragraphs(root):
        process_paragraph(p, data, missing_set)
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="UTF-8", xml_declaration=True)


def main():
    data = load_data()

    # Determine which parts are "active" (body + referenced headers/footers).
    zin = zipfile.ZipFile(TEMPLATE, "r")
    names = zin.namelist()

    # active headers/footers = those referenced in document.xml.rels AND whose
    # relationship is actually referenced by a headerReference/footerReference.
    doc_xml = zin.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
    rels_xml = zin.read("word/_rels/document.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
    # map rId -> target
    rid_target = dict(re.findall(r'Id="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', rels_xml))
    referenced_rids = set(re.findall(r'(?:header|footer)Reference[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"', doc_xml))
    active_parts = {"word/document.xml"}
    for rid in referenced_rids:
        tgt = rid_target.get(rid)
        if tgt:
            active_parts.add("word/" + tgt)

    # pre-scan: does any active part contain the conditional? if so GOVERNING required
    conditional_present = False
    for name in active_parts:
        txt = zin.read(name).decode("utf-8")
        if "IF_RELOCATION" in txt:
            conditional_present = True
            break
    if conditional_present and GOVERNING not in data:
        zin.close()
        fail("Conditional IF_RELOCATION present but required governing field "
             "'%s' is missing from data." % GOVERNING)

    missing_set = set()
    processed = {}
    for name in active_parts:
        processed[name] = process_xml(zin.read(name), data, missing_set)

    if missing_set:
        zin.close()
        fail("Missing required field(s): %s" % ", ".join(sorted(missing_set)))

    # Verify no residual placeholders / control tokens remain in active parts.
    residual = {}
    for name, b in processed.items():
        s = b.decode("utf-8")
        toks = set(TOKEN_RE.findall(s)) | set(
            re.findall(r"\{\{\s*(IF_RELOCATION|END_IF_RELOCATION)\s*\}\}", s))
        if toks:
            residual[name] = toks
    if residual:
        zin.close()
        fail("Residual tokens remain: %s" % residual)

    # Write output zip: copy all entries, replacing processed active parts.
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT), exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUTPUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            if item.filename in processed:
                zout.writestr(item, processed[item.filename])
            else:
                zout.writestr(item, zin.read(item.filename))
    zin.close()
    print("OK: wrote", OUTPUT)
    print("Active parts processed:", sorted(active_parts))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
